entries.title: Asking the first mate to add another computer offers a new card
entries.body: After you answered the first mate's card for adding one computer, asking it to add another was refused. It now offers a new card each time you ask, also after you said Not now, and the same holds for its cards to update, remove or sign in a computer.
entries.noPicture: The add card looks as it did; the fix is that it appears for the next computer instead of a refusal.
